mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_course ( review_check, place1, place2, place3, place4, place5, t_user_email, t_user_id ) VALUES ( #{reviewCheck}, PLACE(#{placeDTO1.locationName}, #{placeDTO1.address}), PLACE(#{placeDTO2.locationName}, #{placeDTO2.address}), PLACE(#{placeDTO3.locationName}, #{placeDTO3.address}), PLACE(#{placeDTO4.locationName}, #{placeDTO4.address}), PLACE(#{placeDTO5.locationName}, #{placeDTO5.address}), #{userEmail}, #{userId} )
mapper.select: SELECT review_check AS reviewCheck, t_user_email AS userEmail, t_user_id AS userId, place1.location_name AS place1LocationName, place1.address AS place1Address, place2.location_name AS place2LocationName, place2.address AS place2Address, place3.location_name AS place3LocationName, place3.address AS place3Address, place4.location_name AS place4LocationName, place4.address AS place4Address, place5.location_name AS place5LocationName, place5.address AS place5Address FROM t_course WHERE id = #{id}
